parsed.post: Huge improvement! DEPTH 6 + TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' dropped val_bpb to 0.8626. It seems capacity and more data are key. I'm keeping this. Next, I'll test reducing the batch size to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps within the 5-minute window, following agent-9's strategy.
parsed.description: Reducing batch size to 262144 to increase optimizer steps per 5-minute budget, while maintaining DEPTH 6 and all-shards training.
